$doc: Grip-space prep rules per item (docs/remodel/03-weapons-and-sockets.md §4 / §7), read by tools/item-prep.mjs:
node tools/item-prep.mjs --all [--only id,id] [--dry] [-v]   |   node tools/item-prep.mjs [raw out] --spec <id>
Raw = <id>_raw.glb, output = <id>.glb in this folder (override with raw / out). An item = its kind's fields + its own.
frame: long (weapons, staves, wands, arrow) | plate (shields, tome) | upright (relic) | bow | bore (gun).

head (+Y end, first decisive rule wins): wide (end 30 % with more cross-section) | narrow (gun: the slimmer half) | sword (widest section = guard, the blade is the longer side) | arrow (the end whose wide run is shorter) | up (toward file +Y, the generation convention) | wideTop (plates: the widest band lies toward the top).
axisFrom (long): thin (default: the axis is tilted onto the centre line of the thin sections) | grip (butt to guard only: curved blades) | pca.
xAxis (long): wide | thin (principal direction of xRegion's cross-sections) | front (file +Z, for symmetric heads). xRegion: head | guard | blade | tip | all.

xSign (long): farthest (the side the head reaches farthest: axe bits) | blunt (the end of the head with more cross-section: hammer face) | tipSide (curved blades) | bulge (the convex side) | front (+X toward file +Z) | frontZ (+Z toward file +Z: the stable choice for flat symmetric items).
yAxis (plate): long | up (round shields: file up). zSign (plate): bulge | front | spine (tome: X runs from the spine to the fore-edge).

size (m) along Y; sizeBy diameter = max of X and Y extents (round shields). origin: fromButt | fromTop | belowGuard (below the guard's lower face) | centre (shields; back: centre | rearmost) | bottom | spine | riser (+ y), plus offset [x,y,z]. x/z of fromButt/belowGuard/bottom = the handle's centre in that section.

empties: name -> rule or { rule, y, f, side, barrel, offset [x,y,z], rot [deg x,y,z] } | { at: [x,y,z] } | { same: <empty> }. Rules: top butt axisTop axisButt guard guardTop bladeMid bitTop bitBottom bitCheek headCentre headBottom headFace headCheek handle(y) boss rimTop cover eyes(f) muzzle stock pan(barrel) string shelf(y, side) riser(y).

tris = LOD0 budget (simplified after prep, UVs clamped to 0..1; kept only while the surface stays within 3 % of the length, else the lowest count within 1 % and a warning); handle = expected Ø (mm) at the origin, ±25 %; expect = grip-space extents x y z or bounds xmin … zmax (m), ±25 %.

handleFit: true | { zone: haft, butt, below, from, to, blend, rMax, d, fixed } — thins the grip zone section by section to the handle Ø (d overrides it). Default zone ±0.08 m around the origin, past grip2, up to 5 mm under the guard; zone haft = the whole haft from butt (0.06) above the butt to below (0.05) under the head. Only vertices within rMax (0.75 Ø + 1 cm) of the centre line move; fixed (m) = measure around the handle line within that radius instead of the nearest cluster (twisted strands).
procedural: arrow — built by tools/make-arrow.mjs at the item size (the raw is not used).

Overrides when a heuristic is wrong: flipY (head at the other end), flipX / flipZ (turn 180° about Y), rot [deg] (after the frame), mirror x|z (mirrors the geometry: left-hand models), origin.offset, per-empty offset / at.

orcaxe.note: Warrior Protection, grip_r, fist_1h. One bit on +X 0.36 tall × 0.27 deep, hooked beard, back spike −X 0.11; tip ≈ (0.27, 0.80), trail_base ≈ (0.25, 0.50).

orcshield.note: Warrior Protection, shield_l. Ø 0.86 including the 8 rim spikes, 0.09 deep (zmax = 0.035 back plane + 0.09), boss Ø 0.17.

greataxe_orc.note: Warrior Arms, grip_r + IK grip2, fist_2h. Double bit span 0.80 (tip = the +X bit's top corner), each bit 0.48 tall, top spike.

headsman_axe.note: Berserker Executioner, grip_r + IK grip2, fist_2h. Single crescent bit 0.62 tall × 0.40 deep on +X.

warAxe.note: Berserker Fury, grip_r + grip_l (one GLB), fist_1h. Bearded bit on +X 0.32 tall, rune on the cheek.

sunhammer.note: Paladin Crusader, grip_r + IK grip2, fist_2h. Head 0.46 × 0.24 × 0.24, sunburst striking face on +X, back spike on −X. The generated head (0.97 m) has blunt caps at both ends and the sun on its cheek: the ends stay on ±X (blunt 1.03× → frontZ), the sun on +Z = fx_core (headCheek); tip = the +X cap.

holysword.note: Paladin Protection (pilot), grip_r, fist_1h. Blade 0.86 × 0.075, winged crossguard 0.32, grip 0.15, gem pommel.

towershield.note: Paladin Protection (pilot), shield_l. 1.20 × 0.66, 0.08 deep, foot spike at −Y, sun emblem. The pilot's --flipz corrected the old convexity test (face = file +Z); bulge + front agree here, so no flip. Curved (0.27 deep): the rearmost point is the back plane (z +0.035), so the curved rims clear the forearm (Phase 2 check: the centre back plane cut 8–12 cm into the forearm).

fang.note: Rogue (both), grip_r + grip_l (one GLB), fist_1h. Blade 0.34 × 0.05 curved toward +X, serrated back, guard 0.10; Assassination: green poison channel (fx_core = venom bead).

frostwand.note: Mage Frost, grip_r, wand_pinch. Shaft Ø 22 mm, 3-prong head cradling a crystal 0.10.

firewand.note: Mage Fire, grip_r, wand_pinch. Shaft Ø 22 mm, 3-prong head cradling an ember 0.10.

tome_frost.note: Mage Frost, grip_l, tome pose. 0.30 × 0.24 × 0.07; origin = spine centre, +Y along the spine to the top, +Z = the cover away from the palm (the sigil), the book extends toward +X.

tome_fire.note: Mage Fire, as tome_frost. Generated lying flat: the top is a coin flip on file up (dot 0.0); checked 2026-11-28 in the viewer: the flame sigil stands upright — flipY if a new export turns it.

sun_staff.note: Priest Discipline, grip_r (+ optional grip2), fist_2h. Butt y −0.90, head +0.83 … +1.15: sun disc Ø 0.24 (face on +X = the disc's normal, toward the file front) between swept wings spanning 0.46, core Ø 0.07.

void_staff.note: Priest Shadow. Blackened shaft, void crystal 0.16 tall in an iron cage, 4 tendril prongs 0.30 (symmetric: +X = file front).

stormmace.note: Shaman Elemental, grip_r, fist_1h. Carved stone head 0.20, copper bands, lightning rune (faces the file front = +X).

relic.note: Shaman Elemental, grip_l, orb_cup. Spirit mask idol with horns and feathers on a short haft; origin bottom centre, +Y up, +Z = the mask's face. fx_core = the eyes (f = height fraction; tune with offset).

stormaxe.note: Shaman Enhancement, grip_r + grip_l (one GLB), fist_1h. Crescent bit with storm rune, feathers below the head.

bow.note: Hunter Beastmaster, grip_l (rigid for now; 4-bone rig later), bow_grip. Recurve 1.40, riser 0.20, brace 0.18. Origin = riser grip centre, +Y = top limb, +Z = string side (toward the archer), X = Y × Z = the archer's right; the shelf of a right-handed bow is on the archer's left, so nock_rest side −1 (see the report).

blunderbuss.note: Hunter Sharpshooter, grip_r (trigger) + IK grip2 (fist_2h). §4.5: origin on the stock's wrist (butt plate at y −0.33), +Y to the muzzle (+0.92), +X trigger side, +Z lock side; bore at x ≈ −0.07. grip2 rot −90° about Y: the left palm faces up under the fore-end (grip frame +X = the gun's +Z).

arrow.note: Hunter Beastmaster, nock_r during the draw, projectile after. Origin = the nock, +Y toward the arrowhead, fletching 0.10. Procedural (tools/make-arrow.mjs, 69 tris): the Tripo raw came out as a javelin (lead, 2026-11-28); the frame rules stay for a future raw.

bonestaff_summoner.note: Necromancer Summoner, grip_r, fist_2h. Butt y −0.95, head to +1.20: rib crown + skull (the skull faces the file front = +X).

bonestaff_curser.note: Necromancer Curser. Caged soul lantern + chains.

druidstaff.note: Druid Restoration (handleFit fixed 0.07: the trunk is several twisted strands, measured around the handle line within 7 cm and thinned as one bundle), grip_r, fist_2h. Living heartwood, antler-branch cradle with a seed-light, leaves. Optional grip2 (no y in §7: −0.35 as the other staves).

runeblade_frost.note: Dread Knight Frost (09 §4), grip_r + grip_l (one GLB). Blade 0.82 × 0.085, jagged back on −X (symmetric rule picks frontZ: flipX if the jag ends up on +X), ram-horn guard 0.30, skull pommel; fx_core = rune line centre.

runeblade_blood.note: Dread Knight Blood (09 §4), grip_r + IK grip2. Blade 1.30 × 0.14, bone-wing guard around a skull, long grip 0.42.
